4 Days Maasai Mara Lake Nakuru Group Joining Safari

Package overview

Explore two of Kenya’s most iconic wildlife destinations—the world-famous —on this budget-friendly group joining safari. This tour combines Big Five game viewing with birdlife and rhino sanctuary experiences.

  • Masai Mara
  • The Great Migration (Seasonal): If traveling between July and October, witness the epic river crossings of millions of wildebeest and zebra across the Mara River.
  • Big Cat Sightings: The Mara is renowned for guaranteed sightings of lions, cheetahs, and leopards—it is one of the best places in the world to see predators in action.
  • Big Five & More: A near-certainty to spot the "Big Five" (lion, leopard, elephant, rhino, buffalo) and countless other species.
  • Hot Air Balloon Safari (Optional): Start your day with a breathtaking sunrise flight over the plains, followed by a champagne breakfast in the bush.
  • Lake Nakuru
  • Rhino sanctuary experience at Lake Nakuru
  • Birdwatching and flamingo sightings

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi - Masai Mara

Depart early morning from Nairobi and join other travelers for a shared safari adventure. Drive through the Great Rift Valley with a brief stop at the viewpoint for photos. Proceed to Maasai Mara, arriving in time for lunch at your camp or lodge. After some relaxation, head out for an afternoon game drive in the reserve. Dinner and overnight at the camp/lodge.

02Day 2 | Full Day Masai Mara

Spend the day exploring the vast plains of the Maasai Mara National Reserve with packed lunch. Search for the Big Five and enjoy sightings of lions, elephants, cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, and more. Visit the Mara River, a key highlight where wildlife activity is often intense. During migration season (July–October), you may witness the spectacular Great Wildebeest Migration . Optional activities: Hot air balloon safari Maasai village cultural visit Dinner and overnight at the camp/lodge.

03Day 3 | Maasai Mara – Lake Nakuru National Park

After breakfast, depart Maasai Mara and drive towards Lake Nakuru National Park . Arrive in time for lunch at your lodge, followed by an afternoon game drive in the park. Lake Nakuru is famous for its large population of rhinos (both black and white), flamingos, and diverse birdlife. You may also spot lions, leopards, and Rothschild giraffes. Dinner and overnight at the lodge.

04Day 4 | Lake Nakuru – Nairobi

Enjoy an early morning game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park , offering another chance to spot wildlife and enjoy the scenic lake views. After breakfast, depart for Nairobi , arriving in the afternoon with drop-off at your hotel or airport.
